concerns_addressed: All four packet GWT outcomes verified against controller and feature tests.
outlet_id derived strictly from authenticated outlet relation; request body outlet_id not used.
Validation of event_uuid, event_type, product_id, occurred_at confirmed; metadata tagged discovery_v1.
Identical replay returns 200 with idempotent_replay=true; conflicting attributes return 409; concurrent-insert race handled.
Non-outlet roles (admin) denied with 403 before validation/persistence.

strengths: Refactored storeDiscoveryEvent() into focused private helpers (validateDiscoveryEventPayload, discoveryEventReplayResponse); main method body now at ~50 lines, within threshold.
Duplicated replay comparison/response logic (initial lookup + race recovery) consolidated into single private helper.
Cross-controller duplication with MeasurementController::storeEvent() acknowledged and documented with rationale for not sharing (different ingestion contracts).
All 4 GWT tests pass; outlet-only authorization enforced before validation; metadata.source = 'discovery_v1' set correctly.
No changes outside the two scoped files; no auto-add or blocking behavior introduced.

issues.description: validateDiscoveryEventPayload() is called only once; inlining would be equally clean, but extraction is an acceptable style choice for readability.
occurred_at parsed twice (Carbon::parse in main method, then format in helper); negligible performance impact.
